bio: Imagine a small cheerful bistro-style dining room whose shelves are laden with fine deli produce, a pretty conservatory and a small terrace. The scene is set to sample tasty food in which tradition is cleverly paired with wayfaring influences: Asian and North-African notes flank the Fujiyama oyster (house specialty), the catch of the day and a seasonal vegetable tajine, or “A night in Essaouira” dessert based on dates, fresh dairy ice cream and honey. Delightful....
